articles.title_en: Floodwaters engulf Russia’s Tyumen. See photos and videos from the scene.
articles.lead_en: Authorities have declared a state of emergency in the Russian city of Tyumen and the surrounding district as flooding continues to worsen. The Tura River has overflowed its banks, inundating neighborhoods across the city and nearby communities.

articles.title_en: Russian city declares state of emergency over flooding. Residents have complained about foul-smelling water and dead fish in the river.
